commands.review_summary:
Adds agent-run abortion when a Tool Search catalog execution returns a result with `details.deniedReason` set to `tool-loop`.

PR surface: Source +7. Total +7 across 1 file.

Reproducibility: yes. —source inspection plus the linked v2026.6.11 logs establish a high-confidence path: repeatedly invoke an identical direct tool until `generic_repeat` returns a critical `tool-loop` denial and observe whether provider turns continue. This review did not independently execute that live scenario.
commands.review_followup: - [P1] The contributor needs to correct the uncovered direct-tool boundary and provide real behavior proof before normal maintainer review can complete.

target.title: fix(agents): terminate agent run on critical loop detection instead of continuing indefinitely
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

When loop detection blocks a tool at critical level (e.g., `generic_repeat` detector, `action=block`, `count=10`), the tool result with `deniedReason: "tool-loop"` was returned to the model normally. The model kept retrying the same tool, and the session continued burning resources for hours (logs show 2.8h of repeated blocked messages after the first critical block).

Fixes #106231.

## Changes

- `src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/attempt.ts` (toolSearchCatalogExecutor):
  After `runToolLifecycle` returns a tool result, check if `details.deniedReason === "tool-loop"`.
  If so, call `abortRun()` to terminate the agent run.
- The current turn's blocked result still reaches the model, but `abortRun()` sets `aborted=true`
  and triggers `runAbortController.abort()`, causing `isStopped()` to return true and
  cancelling any subsequent provider requests.

## Evidence

**Flow verification:**

Before:
```
result (deniedReason=tool-loop) → return result → model retries same tool → ∞ loop
```

After:
```
result (deniedReason=tool-loop) → abortRun() → aborted=true
→ runAbortController.abort() → isStopped()=true → provider cancelled → run terminates
```

**Unit tests (82/82 passed):**

```
LIN-66D8BD4EA2C
2026年 07月 13日 星期一 18:41:26 CST

tool-loop-detection.test.ts:
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  56 passed (56)

agent-tool-definition-adapter.test.ts:
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  26 passed (26)
```

**Lint:** `npx oxlint` — no errors

**Type check:** `pnpm tsgo` — no errors

**Real proof output (abort chain):**

```
Host: LIN-66D8BD4EA2C
PID: 1175895
Time: 2026-07-13T10:41:14.790Z

=== Before (bug) ===
attempt.ts had NO check for deniedReason === 'tool-loop':
  result → return result → model retries → INFINITE LOOP

=== After (fix) ===
attempt.ts:3711-3717 checks deniedReason === 'tool-loop':
  → abortRun() → aborted=true
  → runAbortController.abort()
  → isStopped()=true → no more model turns
  → provider cancelled → run terminated

=== Abort Chain ===
abortRun(false, error):
  → aborted = true
  → runAbortController.abort(error)
    → runAbortController.signal.aborted = true
    → all abort event listeners fire
    → provider requests cancelled
    → next steer message rejected (isStopped=true)
    → agent run terminates cleanly
```

## Review

- Manually reviewed and verified
- AI-assisted: Yes
- Fixes #106231
